cases.sentence: Кроткий ответ отвращает ___, а резкое слово будет ярость.
cases.translation: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
cases.explain: Гнев is the direct object of отвращает (turns away), taking the accusative case.

cases.translation: A gentle tongue is a tree of life.
cases.explain: Дерево is a predicate nominative after the linking verb быть (is).

cases.sentence: Глупец презирает отцовский урок, а слушающий упреки ___.
cases.translation: A fool despises his father's correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.
cases.explain: Благоразумен is the predicate adjective describing the subject слушающий (one who listens).

cases.translation: In the house of the righteous is much treasure.
cases.explain: The genitive plural after много (much/many) is required.

cases.sentence: Уста мудрых распространяют ___, сердца глупцов не таковы.
cases.translation: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.
cases.explain: Знания is the direct object of распространяют (spread), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Путь жизни ведет рассудительных вверх, чтобы спасти их от ___ мертвых внизу.
cases.translation: The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Слушающий благотворный упрек будет как дома среди ___.
cases.translation: The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.
cases.explain: The preposition среди (among) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Страх перед Господом учит ___, и смирение предшествует славе.
cases.translation: The fear of Yahweh teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.
cases.explain: Мудрости is the direct object of учит (teaches), taking the accusative case.

reading.ru: Кроткий ответ отвращает гнев, а резкое слово будет ярость.
reading.question: What does a gentle answer accomplish versus a harsh word?
options: A gentle answer turns away anger while harsh words stir up anger
Both gentle and harsh answers produce the same result
reading.correct: A gentle answer turns away anger while harsh words stir up anger
reading.explain: The verse shows: кроткий ответ отвращает гнев (a gentle answer turns away wrath) versus резкое слово будет ярость (a harsh word stirs up anger).

reading.ru: Язык мудрых восхваляет знания, а уста глупых изрыгают глупость.
reading.question: What is the difference between what wise and foolish people speak?
options: The wise praise knowledge while the foolish spout folly
Both wise and foolish people say the same things
reading.correct: The wise praise knowledge while the foolish spout folly
reading.explain: язык мудрых восхваляет знания (the tongue of the wise commends knowledge) contrasts with уста глупых изрыгают глупость (the mouth of fools gush out folly).

reading.ru: При счастливом сердце лицо сияет, а сердечная скорбь сокрушает дух.
reading.question: How does one's emotional state affect their appearance and spirit?
options: A happy heart makes the face shine while sorrow crushes the spirit
Emotional state has no effect on appearance
reading.correct: A happy heart makes the face shine while sorrow crushes the spirit
reading.explain: The verse contrasts: При счастливом сердце лицо сияет (when the heart is happy, the face shines) with сердечная скорбь сокрушает дух (heartfelt sorrow crushes the spirit).

reading.ru: Лучше немного, но со страхом перед Господом, чем большое богатство и с ним тревога.
reading.question: What is better: poverty with fear of the Lord or wealth with anxiety?
options: Little with fear of the Lord is better than great wealth with anxiety
Poverty is always worse than wealth
Fear of the Lord brings wealth
reading.correct: Little with fear of the Lord is better than great wealth with anxiety
reading.explain: The verse states: Лучше немного, но со страхом перед Господом, чем большое богатство и с ним тревога — Better is little with the fear of the Lord than great treasure with trouble.

reading.ru: Путь лентяя колючками зарос, а дорога праведных гладкая.
reading.question: What is the condition of the paths of the lazy versus the righteous?
options: The path of the lazy is overgrown with thorns while the righteous walk a smooth path
reading.correct: The path of the lazy is overgrown with thorns while the righteous walk a smooth path
reading.explain: The verse shows: Путь лентяя колючками зарос (the way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch) versus дорога праведных гладкая (the path of the upright is a highway).

reading.ru: Страх перед Господом учит мудрости, и смирение предшествует славе.
reading.question: What does fear of the Lord teach, and what precedes glory?
options: Fear of the Lord teaches wisdom and humility precedes glory
reading.correct: Fear of the Lord teaches wisdom and humility precedes glory
reading.explain: The text states: Страх перед Господом учит мудрости (the fear of Yahweh teaches wisdom) and смирение предшествует славе (humility precedes glory).
